args.title: Summary: Saltmarsh retail returns articles (2026)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns and its companion piece (https://insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion):

- Apparel return rates reached 24%, making returns logistics a significant cost pressure for retailers.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
